title: Tree of Doom
body:
Description

The Tree of Doom is a part of the My Island Collab. The Tree of Doom can be sold for studs for the event. This tree can be found all around Finlay. It has red leaves that have a glowing particle effect and the wood of the tree is two different colors that are separate in the material gun. has the wood appearance of darkish brown similar to the stud pine. It gives 125-200 studs in the event.
